Spirit.title:
A memory,

served in the present
Spirit.lead: Héritage was born from a conviction: Cameroonian cuisine deserves the finest tables.
Spirit.body: Here, ndolé, ember-grilled fish and taro with yellow sauce are crafted with the precision of haute cuisine, never betraying the memory of the mothers and grandmothers who passed them on. Produce comes from Yaoundé’s markets, spices from Penja and the West, and the embers give every plate its character.
Spirit.quote: I cook the flavours of my childhood with techniques learned elsewhere. Produce first, fire second, and always sharing.

a house of cuisine
Restaurant.intro: In Bastos, a table where Cameroonian cuisine is told with elegance.

story.title:
From a family kitchen

to a great table
story.p1: It all began around a pot of ndolé, one Sunday, in a family kitchen in Yaoundé. Gestures were handed down, recipes whispered, flavours remained.
story.p2: Héritage gives this cuisine the setting it deserves: an intimate room, attentive service, a curated cellar and plates crafted with the rigour of great houses.
story.p3: Our promise is simple: to help you rediscover dishes you thought you knew.

chef.title:
The right gesture,

the true taste
chef.quote: Cameroonian cuisine has nothing to envy any other. My job is to remove the superfluous so the produce can speak.
chef.p1: Trained between Yaoundé and Europe, our Chef returns to the source with one obsession: embers, local spices and precision at every moment.
chef.p2: The menu follows the markets and the seasons. It changes often but keeps its landmarks: ndolé, ember-grilled fish, poulet DG — reinterpreted, never betrayed.

Legal.publisher: Restaurant Héritage, Bastos district, Yaoundé (Cameroon). Phone: {phone}.
